name: Open Accessibility
description: Provides a block that renders the jQuery-based Open Accessibility toolbar (text zoom, contrast, link highlighting, readable font, etc.) on the front end; assets are bundled locally, not loaded from a CDN.
provides_plugin_types: Block: open_accessibility_block (Open Accessibility) — attaches the open_accessibility/open-accessibility library and passes settings via drupalSettings
project_description:
Description 

This module helps users to access the basic accessibility of the website. It was completely open-source code taken from the Jossef Harush Kadouri's Open Accessibility codes. Free accessibility tools menu for website maintainers powered by jQuery.

 Installation 

 
 Install module using composer or normal way 
 Configure the settings for Open Accessibility 

 /admin/config/user-interface/open-accessibility 
 Provide permission for the access configuration page 
 Place the Open Accessibility Block into your region. 
 
 Reference: 

[1] https://github.com/jossef/open-accessibility
